name: Billard im Gärkeller
kurzbeschreibung: **Billards in the Gärkeller in Innsbruck** – enjoy a game in the historic cellar of the **Brauhaus Tyrol** with a cold **Tiroler Bier** in hand. Whether you're a seasoned player or just starting out, the cozy atmosphere and expert tips from the staff make every shot a pleasure. Afterward, treat yourself to a hearty **Kaiserschmarrn** or a classic **Schweinsbraten**—just steps away from the vibrant heart of Innsbruck.
